instruction:
You have been tasked with designing a Verilog module that generates a triangular wave with a frequency of 1 kHz and a peak-to-peak voltage of 2V. The triangular wave should have a rising slope of 1V/us and a falling slope of -1V/us. The output should be a single-ended signal with a voltage swing from 0V to 2V. The module should have a single input `clk` which is a 50 MHz clock signal. 

Write a Verilog module that meets the above requirements.
